<translate>
'''Afterimage''' is an evasion technique that leaves an image of you behind while you move at high speed. With a locked-on target it lets you blink around the enemy and reappear behind it; without one, it is a quick sidestep forward. Mobs that were targeting you lose track of you.
</translate>

<translate>
== Learning it ==

Afterimage costs '''2,500 TP'''. It is taught by [[Special:MyLanguage/Master Roshi|Master Roshi]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Krillin|Krillin]] (both Good alignment) and by [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]] (Evil alignment). Like every evasion technique, it needs [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], an empty main hand and at least 5% Power Release, and it must be equipped in a technique slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works ==

Press the technique's slot key. What happens depends on whether you are locked on:

* '''With a locked-on target within 24 blocks''', you blink around it a few times and end up behind it.
* '''Without a target''', you leave an afterimage behind and step a few blocks forward.

Either way, mobs targeting you within '''16 blocks''' lose track of you. Lock on with {{Key|Z}}; your lock-on range depends on [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Sense|Ki Sense]].

After using it, all your evasion techniques share a short lockout (the technique's duration + 3 seconds).
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades ==

Afterimage gains experience every time you use it. Spend it in the Skills menu on '''duration''' (+2.5% per level, up to +50%) and '''cooldown'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes ==

* For a long-range version that teleports you behind a target up to 64 blocks away, see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dimensional Warp|Dimensional Warp]].
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Instant Transmission|Instant Transmission]] can also put you behind a target, using the dash cooldown instead of the evasion lockout.
</translate>
